node.statement: Because H=dist_1(p_v,C) by the hidden-top-vertex hypothesis and distance to a set is 1-Lipschitz in its point argument, H<=dist_1(q,C)+||p_v-q||_1. Nodes 1.2 and 1.3 bound the two terms by sigma_v H and nu_v*(2+4*delta), respectively, so H<=sigma_v H+nu_v*(2+4*delta); subtracting sigma_v H from both sides gives H*(1-sigma_v)<=nu_v*(2+4*delta).
